verdict.rationale: Adyen's own docs and product page directly document Tap to Pay: an iPhone can serve as the payment interface for contactless in-person payments, and compatible smartphones or tablets become Tap to Pay checkouts with no extra hardware. This covers the core of the story, accepting contactless payments on an off-the-shelf phone without buying a reader. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on device and platform compatibility beyond iPhone (Android is not named explicitly), and evidence that a founder can use it without building a custom app integration (the iOS doc sits under a 'build' integration path).

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept contactless card payments on an off-the-shelf phone (Tap to Pay) without buying a reader

citations.quote: With our Tap to Pay on iPhone solution you can accept contactless in-person payments using an iPhone as the payment interface, and process these payments on the Adyen payments platform.
Turn compatible smartphones or tablets into Tap to Pay checkouts. No extra hardware required.
